stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Bruce uses the Infinity Stones to undo the snap, bringing Peter back after five years, and they fight on the same side in the final battle.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man. One of the people his snap brings back.
stages.whoB: The Hulk, whose snap brings him back after five years.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Forgotten by the world, Peter poses as a student named Ned Leeds to ask Bruce about his inhibitor. When Jean Grey's control wakes the old Hulk, Peter fights him and reaches Bruce by telling him he is Peter, his friend.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man. He asks about the inhibitor, then talks the Hulk down.
stages.whoB: Bruce, whose inhibitor he studies. He fights the Hulk to bring Bruce back.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the snap, Nebula leads Thor and the Avengers to the Garden, and Thor beheads Thanos once she confirms he is telling the truth. After the final battle, Thor leaves Earth with the Guardians and becomes Nebula's teammate.
stages.whoA: Thanos's daughter. She leads him to Thanos, then becomes his teammate.
stages.whoB: The Avenger who kills Thanos at the Garden, then joins the Guardians.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Rocket fights Thanos's army in Wakanda. When Thanos snaps his fingers, Groot turns to dust in front of Rocket.
stages.whoA: The Titan whose snap turns Groot to dust in front of him.
stages.whoB: A Guardian who fights his army in Wakanda and loses Groot to his snap.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Rocket joins the Avengers' strike on Thanos at the Garden, only to find the Stones destroyed. Later he fights an earlier Thanos and his army in the final battle.
stages.whoA: The Titan he helps ambush at the Garden, then fights again on Earth.
stages.whoB: One of the Avengers who ambush him at the Garden.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: In Wakanda, Shuri works to remove the Mind Stone from Vision so that Wanda can destroy it. Wanda stands guard over her lab while the battle rages outside.
stages.whoA: T'Challa's sister, who tries to remove the Mind Stone from Vision.
stages.whoB: The Avenger who guards her lab, waiting to destroy the Mind Stone.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: The Guardians answer a distress call and pull Thor from the wreck of the Statesman. Drax is openly impressed by him, calling Thor a handsome, muscular man next to Quill.
stages.whoA: A Guardian who helps pull him from the wreck and openly admires him.
stages.whoB: The Asgardian the Guardians rescue from space, whom he openly admires.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: When Thor joins the Guardians after the final battle, Drax suggests that Thor and Quill fight each other to decide who leads the team. They both laugh it off.
stages.whoA: His new teammate on the Guardians.
stages.whoB: A new teammate, who he hopes will fight Quill to lead the team.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Rhodes and Thor are fellow Avengers. At the party in Avengers Tower, Thor is unimpressed by Rhodes's war story, and they fight side by side against Ultron in Sokovia.
stages.whoA: A fellow Avenger. Unimpressed by his war story, but beside him in Sokovia.
stages.whoB: War Machine. A fellow Avenger, beside him against Ultron in Sokovia.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: After Sokovia, Wanda joins Rhodes, Vision and Sam as the new Avengers, training together at the Avengers Compound.
stages.whoA: A new Avenger who trains with him at the Compound.
stages.whoB: War Machine. A fellow new Avenger at the Compound.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: The Sokovia Accords put them on opposite sides. At the Leipzig airport, Wanda hurls cars at Rhodes, and he brings her down with a sonic cannon.
stages.whoA: On Steve's side of the Accords. He brings her down at the airport.
stages.whoB: War Machine, on Tony's side. He brings her down at the airport.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Rhodes defies Ross to stand with the fugitive Avengers again, and he and Wanda go to Wakanda together to protect Vision and the Mind Stone.
stages.whoA: A teammate again, protecting Vision in Wakanda.
stages.whoB: A teammate again, who defies Ross to help protect Vision.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the snap, Rocket and Rhodes are among the Avengers who keep working together. Trapped under the rubble of the Avengers Compound, Rhodes frees Rocket, and they fly into the final battle with Rocket riding on his back.
stages.whoA: A fellow Avenger after the snap. He frees him from the rubble.
stages.whoB: A fellow Avenger who frees him from the rubble, then carries him into battle.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: When Killmonger takes the throne, Ross flees with Ramonda, Shuri and Nakia to the Jabari. Ramonda distrusts the American agent until Nakia vouches for him as a friend.
stages.whoA: T'Challa's mother, the queen he flees with to the Jabari.
stages.whoB: The American agent who flees with her family. She distrusts him at first.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Claire treats Mrs. Cardenas when Foggy and Karen bring her in after the bombings. When Foggy unmasks a badly hurt Matt, he calls Claire to patch him up, and she reveals she has known Matt's secret all along.
stages.whoA: The nurse who patches Matt up and knew his secret first.
stages.whoB: Matt's best friend, who calls her when Matt is badly hurt.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Ned is Peter's best friend and his guy in the chair. He calls Happy to warn him that the Avengers' cargo plane is in danger, but Happy brushes him off.
stages.whoA: Peter's best friend, whose warning about the plane he brushes off.
stages.whoB: Tony's head of security, who brushes off his warning about the plane.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: In London, Happy finds Ned and his classmates and hides them from Mysterio's drones in the Tower of London. Believing they are about to die, Happy confesses that he is in love with May.
stages.whoA: One of the kids he shelters from Mysterio's drones in London.
stages.whoB: The man who hides them from Mysterio's drones in London.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: In London, Happy finds MJ and her classmates and hides them from Mysterio's drones in the Tower of London, where MJ smashes one with a mace.
stages.whoA: Peter's friend, one of the kids he shelters from Mysterio's drones.
stages.whoB: Tony's former head of security, who hides them from Mysterio's drones.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Powell, a corrupt officer in Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Task Force, arrests Karen during a protest at City Hall. He is a witness at her trial, which ends with her cleared of all charges.
stages.whoA: A corrupt Task Force cop who arrests her and testifies at her trial.
stages.whoB: Daredevil's ally, whom he arrests at a City Hall protest.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Sif comes to Earth hunting the escaped Asgardian Lorelei, and Coulson's team helps her track Lorelei down and capture her. Sif is shocked to find Coulson alive and agrees to keep it from Thor.
stages.whoA: An Asgardian warrior he helps capture Lorelei.
stages.whoB: The agent Thor believes is dead. He helps her capture Lorelei.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: As an agent of the SSR, Peggy fights Red Skull's HYDRA alongside Steve. When Red Skull takes off in the Valkyrie to bomb America, she and Colonel Phillips chase it down the runway so Steve can get aboard.
stages.whoA: HYDRA's leader. She chases his plane down the runway so Steve can board.
stages.whoB: An SSR agent who storms his base and chases his plane.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: During the hostage crisis at Harlem's Paradise, Shades finds Claire tending to a wounded Misty. Claire attacks him from behind and helps Misty take him down, and as he is led to the police van, she steps on his trademark sunglasses.
stages.whoA: Diamondback's man. She takes him down and crushes his sunglasses.
stages.whoB: The nurse who knocks him down and stomps on his sunglasses.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Kraglin is Yondu's first mate, and the Ravagers team up with the Guardians against Ronan. When Drax calls the Sakaarans paper people, Kraglin likes it so much he punches him on the shoulder.
stages.whoA: Yondu's first mate, who fights beside them against Ronan.
stages.whoB: A Guardian whose paper people line he loves.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Kraglin is now a member of the Guardians, and he flies with Drax and the team on their missions across the galaxy.
stages.whoA: A fellow Guardian now, welcomed into the team.
stages.whoB: A fellow Guardian on the team that welcomes him.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Cassie is part of Janet's family now, through Scott and Hope. When Cassie shows off the satellite she built to signal the Quantum Realm, Janet frantically shuts it off, but it pulls them all in, and Janet fights to bring her home from Kang.
stages.whoA: Scott's daughter, whose signal pulls them all into the Quantum Realm.
stages.whoB: Hope's mother, who tries to shut off her signal to the Quantum Realm.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Thor brings Jane to Asgard, and Odin tells her she does not belong there and tries to send her home. When he sees the Aether inside her, he keeps her in the palace and tells her its history.
stages.whoA: Thor's father, the king who says a mortal does not belong in Asgard.
stages.whoB: Thor's mortal love, who carries the Aether. He wants her gone.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: When Loki takes the throne, Heimdall lets Sif and the Warriors Three use the Bifrost to bring Thor home, defying Loki's orders. After Loki strikes him down, Sif and the others carry the wounded Heimdall to be healed.
stages.whoA: An Asgardian warrior he lets pass to bring Thor home.
stages.whoB: Asgard's gatekeeper, who lets her pass to bring Thor home.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: During the breakout at Red Hook, North and the Task Force open fire on the fleeing prisoners, and Karen shoots back to cover their escape. North later testifies at her trial, admitting he was only told she drove the getaway vehicle.
stages.whoA: A Task Force officer she trades fire with at Red Hook.
stages.whoB: The getaway driver he shoots at, then testifies against.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Korg travels with Jane, Thor and Valkyrie to Omnipotence City to recruit the gods against Gorr. When Zeus turns on them, Korg fights beside them.
stages.whoA: Thor's Kronan friend, beside her on the trip to Omnipotence City.
stages.whoB: The Mighty Thor. He fights beside her in Omnipotence City.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: When Loki arrives through the Tesseract, he takes control of both Selvig and Clint with his scepter. Under his spell, Selvig builds the device that will open the portal, and Clint gets him what he needs, including iridium.
stages.whoA: The agent watching over his work. Then both fall under Loki's spell.
stages.whoB: The scientist he watches over. Then both fall under Loki's spell.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: After the siege of Harlem's Paradise, Captain Ridley has Shades arrested and questions him, but he only repeats that he wants a lawyer.
stages.whoA: One of the gang leaders she arrests after the siege.
stages.whoB: The police captain who arrests and questions him.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Shades offers to testify against Mariah in return for full immunity. Ridley is against the deal, but agrees once Misty convinces her.
stages.whoA: Her witness against Mariah, given the immunity she did not want to give.
stages.whoB: The captain who signs off on his immunity deal.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Tony visits May's apartment in Queens to recruit Peter, saying he has come to offer her nephew a grant. He charms her, complimenting her walnut date loaf.
stages.whoA: Peter's aunt, whom he charms when he comes to recruit Peter.
stages.whoB: The billionaire who turns up offering Peter a grant, and charms her.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Ned is Peter's best friend and a regular at the Parkers' apartment. May lets him in to build Lego with Peter and drives the two of them to Liz's party.
stages.whoA: Peter's best friend, always at the apartment building Lego.
stages.whoB: Peter's aunt, who drives him and Peter to Liz's party.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Morita is one of the men Steve frees from a HYDRA camp, and he joins the Howling Commandos. He runs the unit's radio during the final assault on HYDRA.
stages.whoA: One of their own, freed from HYDRA's camp. He runs their radio.
stages.whoB: His unit under Captain America, formed from the men freed from HYDRA.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: When Maggie sinks into despair after Matt's birth, Jack begs Father Lantom for help. Lantom takes Maggie back to the church, leaving Jack alone with their baby son.
stages.whoA: Maggie's husband, who begs for his help. He leaves him with baby Matt.
stages.whoB: The priest who takes Maggie away, leaving him alone with baby Matt.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: After Mariah's arrest, District Attorney Blake Tower personally prosecutes her, charging her with murders that include her own cousin, Cottonmouth.
stages.whoA: The crime boss he personally prosecutes for murder.
stages.whoB: The district attorney who prosecutes her for her many murders.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Thor meets Miek and Korg in the Grandmaster's cells for the Contest of Champions. Miek joins the revolt and follows Thor's people on their journey to Earth.
stages.whoA: Korg's friend from the gladiator cells, who joins the revolt.
stages.whoB: The fellow gladiator whose revolt and people she joins.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the snap, Miek lives with Korg in New Asgard and keeps Thor company through his years of grief.
stages.whoA: Korg's friend, who keeps him company in his grief.
stages.whoB: Her friend, whom she keeps company in his years of grief.
